propositions: Rebar hardcodes DC comment ceiling at 32767 chars, silently truncating comments when an administrator has raised the limit via jira.text.field.character.limit (range 0 to 2147483647), causing permanent divergence between local and remote comment bodies.

The sanitize_comment function reuses fit_outbound from the description fitter, creating coupling that makes description fitter changes retarget comments despite differing character semantics (description fitter measures ADF-serialized size on Cloud).

The configurable ceiling must default to 32767 per jira.text.field.character.limit's documented default and JRASERVER-28519, and must be settable via config key ReconcilerConfig.comment_max_chars with range 0 (unlimited) to 2147483647.

Auto-discovery of the live ceiling from /rest/api/2/application-properties is not viable because that endpoint requires Administer Jira permission while rebar authenticates as an ordinary user PAT; configuration is the supported remedy.

The constant WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT is misattributed in comments to Cloud comment limits rather than jira.text.field.character.limit, reversing the actual causality and obscuring the hardcoded value's source and adjustability.
